explanations.literacy: Strong workforce readiness supports advanced services, aerospace, and digital sectors with broad technical literacy.
explanations.infrastructure: Resilient interstate highways, ports, and electrical transmission support predictable logistics and export competitiveness.
explanations.urbanisation: Mature metropolitan corridors sustain deep corporate services, thick skilled labor pools, and efficient supply hubs.
explanations.sentiment: Balanced household confidence keeps personal consumption steady (~68% of GDP) without destabilizing price spikes.
explanations.productivity: Modern industrial capital stock sustains competitive global output per worker across services and manufacturing.
explanations.equality: Broad middle-class purchasing power anchors household demand while preserving healthy incentives for entrepreneurship and R&D.
explanations.racialEquality: Broad anti-discrimination protections widen opportunity across metros, though regional wealth and housing gaps persist.
explanations.crimeControl: Consistent local policing and prosecution contain violent & property crime without excessive fiscal drag.
